findings.title: Missing Schema.org Product and Offer structured data on commercial product page
findings.evidence:
https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/ contains 0 JSON-LD blocks, omitting machine-readable Product and Offer metadata for subscription pricing tiers, feature lists, and regional availability.
Additional evidence (citation-simulator): Simulated search for 'How much does Mozilla VPN cost?' returned fragmented third-party answers (Security.org, Apple App Store, VPN.com) with conflicting tier figures ($3.75/mo to $4.99/mo) rather than direct extraction from https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/ where official pricing is published without Schema.org Offer markup.

suggested_action.summary: Add Schema.org Product and Offer JSON-LD to commercial product pages.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a JSON-LD script tag on /products/vpn/ specifying @type 'Product' with nested 'Offer' elements defining price, priceCurrency, billing duration, and availability.

findings.title: Missing XML sitemap declared in robots.txt or available at /sitemap.xml
findings.evidence: Request to https://www.mozilla.org/sitemap.xml returned HTTP 404 and https://www.mozilla.org/robots.txt contains no 'Sitemap:' directive, increasing crawl discovery cost for search engines and AI web indexing agents.

suggested_action.summary: Publish an XML sitemap and declare its location in robots.txt.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Generate a comprehensive sitemap.xml covering localized routes and add 'Sitemap: https://www.mozilla.org/sitemap.xml' to the root robots.txt file.

findings.title: Missing Organization JSON-LD markup on primary root homepage
findings.evidence: https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/ contains 0 JSON-LD schema blocks, missing root Organization identity, official logo, and sameAs authoritative social and entity links directly on the primary domain landing page.

suggested_action.summary: Add Organization JSON-LD markup to the homepage.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add an Organization schema block on https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/ with name ('Mozilla'), url ('https://www.mozilla.org'), logo, and sameAs links to Wikipedia, Wikidata, GitHub, and official social channels.

findings.title: Broken navigation links on Firefox product landing page due to unresolved cross-domain relative paths
findings.evidence: Internal header navigation links on https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/ use root-relative paths that resolve to 404 dead ends on mozilla.org: https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/browsers/enterprise/ (404), https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/whatsnew/ (404), and https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/features/ (404).

suggested_action.summary: Fix relative navigation links on the Firefox subpage or route them to their canonical firefox.com destinations.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Update header navigation links in the Firefox template on mozilla.org to point to absolute URLs on https://www.firefox.com/ or configure reverse-proxy/redirect rules on mozilla.org for /en-US/browsers/enterprise/, /en-US/whatsnew/, and /en-US/features/.

findings.title: Missing sameAs entity disambiguation and governance structure on root domain
findings.evidence: The root domain homepage https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/ and about page https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/ lack sameAs entity links and Schema.org disambiguation to distinguish Mozilla Foundation (non-profit parent) from Mozilla Corporation (taxable subsidiary), relying solely on external knowledge graphs.

suggested_action.summary: Add sameAs disambiguation links and subsidiary structure to Organization schema on the root domain.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add Organization JSON-LD to https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/ including sameAs URIs for Wikidata (Q9661, Q169925) and Wikipedia, explicitly defining the parentOrganization / subOrganization relationship.

findings.title: Missing machine-readable dateModified and datePublished metadata on policy and documentation content
findings.evidence: Pages such as https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/manifesto/ and https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/ provide foundational organizational principles and policies but lack dateModified/datePublished metadata or Article/WebPage schema, making it difficult for AI engines to machine-verify document currency.

suggested_action.summary: Add datePublished and dateModified metadata to policy and about documents.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Include schema.org 'dateModified' in JSON-LD or standard <meta property="article:modified_time"> on all durable documentation and manifesto pages.

findings.title: Missing breadcrumb structured navigation on deep subpages
findings.evidence: Pages across https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/ and https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/about/ lack Breadcrumb navigation landmarks and BreadcrumbList schema, impairing orientation for users landing directly from search or citations.

suggested_action.summary: Add breadcrumbs with BreadcrumbList schema to product and information pages.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Implement a visual breadcrumb trail (e.g. Home > Products > Mozilla VPN) with semantic <nav aria-label="Breadcrumb"> and Schema.org BreadcrumbList JSON-LD.

proactive_recommendations.title: Adopt llms.txt and llms-full.txt machine-readable documentation manifests
proactive_recommendations.rationale: While not a defect, emerging AI indexing standards (llms.txt) provide concise markdown summaries and curated link maps specifically tailored for Large Language Model retrieval and RAG context windows, giving Mozilla a direct channel to control how AI engines summarize its product portfolio, open-source governance, and privacy manifestos.

suggested_action.summary: Publish /llms.txt and /llms-full.txt summarizing Mozilla's mission, products, and documentation links.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Deploy a concise /llms.txt at the root of mozilla.org linking to markdown-formatted summaries of Firefox, Mozilla VPN, Mozilla Monitor, MDN, and the Mozilla Manifesto.

proactive_recommendations.title: Implement Schema.org FAQPage markup on product feature and support pages
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Mozilla's product pages provide clear answers to common user questions (e.g. server count, device limits, privacy guarantees, logging policies). Wrapping these existing Q&A sections in FAQPage JSON-LD allows AI assistants and search engines to directly extract authoritative answers for high-intent conversational queries.

suggested_action.summary: Embed FAQPage JSON-LD on high-intent product FAQ sections.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add FAQPage schema with Question and Answer mainEntity pairs on https://www.mozilla.org/en-US/products/vpn/ and related product FAQ sections.

proactive_recommendations.title: Introduce cross-product account status and session continuation cues on mozilla.org
proactive_recommendations.rationale: Mozilla operates an interconnected suite of privacy tools (Firefox, VPN, Monitor, Relay, MDN Plus) linked by Mozilla Accounts (FxA). Surfacing personalized sign-in state or contextual continuation prompts on mozilla.org helps returning users immediately access their active subscriptions and privacy dashboards, reducing conversion friction.

suggested_action.summary: Surface Mozilla Account sign-in indicators and direct dashboard shortcuts on the main domain.
suggested_action.how_to_fix: Add a lightweight account avatar/status indicator in the global header linked to the Mozilla Accounts dashboard (accounts.firefox.com) when an active session is detected.
